svg.title: MiniFrontier Modern architecture
svg.desc: Decoder-only stack of four layers in a three-local-then-one-global pattern, with tied embedding and lm_head. One local block is expanded to show pre-RMSNorm, grouped-query attention with QK-norm applied before RoPE and a sliding window, a residual add, a second pre-RMSNorm, SwiGLU feed-forward and a second residual add.
svg.text: q / k / v proj · 4 q, 2 kv
QK-norm on q, k → then RoPE
global — every 4th layer, full causal, NoPE optional
